description: Package declares the month and year in which the commodity was manufactured, pre-packed, or imported.
review_note: This clause's own first proviso is unambiguous: 'Provided that for packages containing food articles, the provisions of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954 and the rules made there under shall apply' -- i.e. food packages are explicitly routed away from this LMPC rule to the food-law equivalent (now FSSAI). Because FSSAI-specific rules are Advanced/deferred scope in this project, this rule is deliberately excluded for packaged_food and will not fire in the MVP. Month/year-of-manufacture checking for food should be re-added under an FSSAI rule set when that layer is built, not under this LMPC rule -- do not silently re-include packaged_food here without also citing the FSSAI source.
